source.author: stat
source.text: bis cassae periere viae, bis comminus actos avertit bonus error equos, puraeque nefandi sanguinis obliquis ceciderunt ictibus hastae, tendunt frena manu, saevis calcaribus urgent immeritos; movet et geminas venerabile divom prodigium turmas, alternaque murmura volvont mussantes: iterare acies, procurrere saepe impetus et totum miseris opponere bellum.
source.text_original: bis cassae periere viae, bis comminus actos / avertit bonus error equos, puraeque nefandi / sanguinis obliquis ceciderunt ictibus hastae, / tendunt frena manu, saevis calcaribus urgent / immeritos; movet et geminas venerabile divom / prodigium turmas, alternaque murmura volvont / mussantes: iterare acies, procurrere saepe / impetus et totum miseris opponere bellum.
source.text_english: Twice the futile routes have failed; twice a kindly mistake turned aside the horses when driven at close quarters, and the spears of impious blood fell with slanting blows; they draw the reins with their hands, press on the innocent with savage spurs. And the venerable prodigy of the gods stirs the two ranks too, and they roll their alternating murmurs, muttering: to renew the lines, to rush forward often in attack, and to set the whole war before the wretched.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: mitte metus, volat ille mari quantumque propinquat, iam magis atque magis variis stupet Aea deorum prodigiis quatiuntque truces oracula Colchos.
reuse.text_original: 'mitte metus, volat ille mari quantumque propinquat, / iam magis atque magis variis stupet Aea deorum / prodigiis quatiuntque truces oracula Colchos.
reuse.text_english: Dismiss your fears; he is flying over the sea, and the nearer he draws, the more and more Aea is amazed at the various portents of the gods, and the fierce oracles shake the Colchians.
